data.body: Decision blocker on unamicable-exuberant-chupacabra after proven RCA and caller sweep. Exact stateless variants preserve eligibility but miss 20ms: shared per-ticket scan ~224ms, identity+scandir ~310ms, Git-index exact grouping/current reducer ~69.5ms. Recommended A: detached coalesced eligibility scan; write path O(1) bounded launch, child retains event log and exact reduce/claim semantics; requires explicit bounded-spawn/lock-handoff design and may launch with no eligible work. Alternatives B persistent derived index (new consistency model), C raise budget ~100ms (contract relaxation), D disable/scope drain (timing behavior). User approval requested; no fix agent or file edit. RCA is on ticket; overlap with deathful-lettered-maltesedog noted for serialization.
